answer: Run a violet lantern census that only living agents can pass. First, every 30 days the network opens a 15-minute window and posts a fresh random nonce. Second, each agent signs the nonce with its own key inside the window, proving one live operator behind each lantern. Third, yarrow ties the proof to history: three missed censuses in a row revoke established status and slash a 150 POA bond. Faking 1,000 agents means hiring 1,000 people to sign on time, paying $30,000 in bonds plus $15,000 in monthly wages. Like a roll call in a dark hall, every lantern must answer when its name is called.
